items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I was close friends with the Dead End Kids in those days and Gabe Rodell was visiting me on the day that they were shooting the pictures

ctx.x: That was one of my manager's creations. He set up a picture shooting session for me and they came to my house and I was close friends with the Dead End Kids in those days and Gabe Rodell was visiting me on the day that they were shooting the pictures and Gabe came over his dog, so they put Gabe's dog into the picture with me and they said George Handy sitting at home with his dog, Forgetful.
That's the story of my dog, Forgetful.
